title: Platform Job Error Details
description: Structured, machine-readable failure details (Error details & codes) returned by the external agent API for terminal jobs. Each failed or stopped job is classified into a stable code with a category, failing pipeline stage, retryability flag and a static recovery hint.

RecoveryHint.description: Static, client-facing guidance. Never contains dynamic values.

stage.description: Failing pipeline stage when determinable from the logs (e.g. "Type Check", "Tests", "Push"). Null when unknown.

message.description: Human-readable error message. When the task.error column holds a structured envelope, this is the envelope message (never raw JSON).

retryable.description: True when resubmitting the job has a realistic chance of success.

failedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the failure was recorded, when known.
